name: quick-share
title: Quick Share
description: Quickly share the active browser tab or a note to one or more Slack channels.
author: peinan

commands.name: link-note
commands.title: Share Active Browser Tab to Slack
commands.description: Share the active browser tab to one or more Slack channels with an optional comment.

commands.name: quick-note
commands.title: Send Quick Note to Slack
commands.description: Send a text-only note to one or more Slack channels.

commands.name: template-editor
commands.title: Edit Message Template
commands.description: Edit the Slack message template used by Share Active Browser Tab to Slack.

preferences.name: slackBotToken
preferences.title: Slack Bot Token
preferences.description: Bot token (xoxb-...) with chat:write, channels:read, and groups:read scopes.

preferences.name: defaultChannels
preferences.title: Default Channels
preferences.description: Comma-separated channel names or IDs to pre-select.

preferences.name: quickNoteDefaultChannels
preferences.title: Quick Note Default Channels
preferences.description: Comma-separated channel names or IDs to pre-select for Quick Note.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
